text:
Priya S: Heads-up — flying into AMS tomorrow, landing 7:15am. Need a bakery or café near Dam Square that opens early and has decent vegan options (looking for a good vegan croissant or tofu scramble). Any favorites?
Jon H: Nice—there's a tiny place I like, Bakkerij De Laat. Opens 06:30 on weekdays. solid croissants but call ahead for vegan. :croissant:
Ava: Try Vegabond Cafe (Kinkerstraat) — fully plant-based, opens 08:00 tho, bit of a tram ride. If you can’t wait, the train + 10min walk works.
Samir: There's a place called Metropole bakery (next to the Flower Market) that sometimes does vegan almond croissants. Not guaranteed but hit-or-miss.
Priya S: Thanks! timing is tight, 7:15 landing -> probably luggage -> 45 min to Dam. Sounds like 08:00 places might work.
maria-dev: @Priya S if you only have carry-on, you can do tram 2/12 from Central — arrives Dam ~15min. Here's a tiny route I use:
```
Centraal -> Tram 2/12 -> Stop: Dam
Walk 3 min to Spui/Dam square
```
Jon H: Also: Back-Up plan: Starbucks at Damrak opens early and has almond croissants. Not artisanal but reliable.
Ava: If you want fully local vibe and faster, pick up a stroopwafel from the market and grab coffee at Lot Sixty One — opens 07:30 and is ~6min from Dam.
Samir: Quick poll: want "local bakery (artisan)" or "fast + guaranteed open"? React with :baguette_bread: for local artisan, :rocket: for fast/guaranteed.
Priya S: Voting: :baguette_bread: leaning artisan but don't want to miss meeting. Anybody willing to text place if it's vegan?
maria-dev: I can — I live nearby, happy to check the Bakkerij De Laat menu and DM you. :thumbsup:
travel-bot: Flight arrival reminder set. ETA to Dam (typical): 45-60m depending on luggage. Good luck!
Priya S: Awesome, thanks everyone. If Bakkerij De Laat is open and has vegan croissant, I’ll try that. If not, Lot Sixty One + stroopwafel it is. :airplane: :coffee:
